# Which roles answer a status hue?

Read this when your style plugin answers the hue a status, a tone or a category takes inside a component.

| role | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fill-confirm-final` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-danger-edge` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-danger-fill-soft` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-danger-fill-strong` | keyword | none | none |
| `--hue-danger-ink` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-danger-on-ink` | color | none | `{color.base-100}` |
| `--hue-info-edge` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-info-fill-soft` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-info-fill-strong` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-info-ink` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-info-on-ink` | color | none | `{color.info-content}` |
| `--hue-success-edge` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-success-fill-soft` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-success-fill-strong` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-success-ink` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-success-on-ink` | color | none | `{color.success-content}` |
| `--hue-warning-edge` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-warning-fill-soft` | color | none | none |
| `--hue-warning-fill-strong` | color | none | none |
